The '''Al Kharid Rooftop Course''' is a [[Rooftop Agility Course]] located in [[Al Kharid]] that is available to players with an [[Agility]] level of 20 or higher. It is preceded by the [[Draynor Village Rooftop Course]] and followed by the [[Varrock Rooftop Course]].

The Al Kharid Rooftop Agility course can be started by climbing the Rough Wall on the north side of [[Ellis]] the Tanner's building and is finished by jumping off a building east of the [[Zeke's Superior Scimitars|scimitar shop]]. Players get 216 experience points from completing the course, which is more evenly spread throughout the course, unlike other agility courses.

It is possible to fail the ''Cross Tightrope 1'' and ''Teeth-grip Zip Line'' obstacles during the course, taking 1-5 damage each time.

A player can complete this course in 64.2 seconds (107 ticks). Using this course, one can gain up to around 12,100 experience per hour.

This course is not recommended over [[Draynor Village Rooftop Course]] for accounts without access to [[Energy-restoring items]] such as [[Stamina potion]] because it is possible to run out of energy on this course, thus lowering the XP rate below that of Draynor's course. Furthermore, the rate at which one receives [[Mark of grace|Marks of grace]] is slightly lower on this course.
